messages:
maya: Quick question 1: we need a concise decision for the roadmap: when a SOC2 customer enables BYOK, do we require a pre-rotation export handshake as mandatory or offer it as opt-in? Two customers pushed for mandatory drills.

sam: Security: mandatory handshake recommended. Without it we risk unrecoverable evidence and auditors will escalate. Also prevents accidental key destruction.

zhen: Eng: mandatory adds complexity (pre-rotation webhook, export token lifecycle). But it's doable as a feature flag per-tenant. Effort: ~2 sprints for API + manifest writes.

eli: Ops: mandatory drill increases support load but reduces emergency escalations. Also simplifies runbook because we can assume exports exist. SLA for retrieval still needs tiers.

nina: CS: customers want guarantees. If it's opt-in, many will forget and then blame us at audit time. Recommend mandatory for enterprise tier only, opt-in for lower tiers.

maya: Compromise proposal: default for enterprise plans = mandatory pre-rotation handshake + dry-run drill each quarter; for lower tiers default = opt-in with clear warnings and an email reminder before rotation.

sam: Agree with compromise. Add security requirement: daily manifest + HSM-signed root must be created before any rotation is allowed.

zhen: Also add mechanical block: if pre-rotation handshake not completed, KMS rotation API returns 422 with guidance and an accepted bypass token requiring legal sign-off.

maya: Launch criteria for this decision: API + webhook implemented, manifest signing in place, product billing flag for enterprise, runbook for ops, and legal template for bypass consent.

ops-bot: Created infra ticket INF-7222 for pre-rotation webhook + manifest signing (https://redwood.internal/INF-7222) :robot_face:

maya: Ok will capture in RFC and schedule stakeholder sync. If no objections I'll mark as candidate decision and start scoping.

nina: +1 from CS.

sam: +1 from Sec.

zhen: +1 from Eng, will scope tickets.
